narrative.overview:
A portfolio laid out as a container bay plan. Every coloured surface is a corrugated steel box in oxide red, ocean blue, mustard, forest green or bare steel, set on yard concrete under asphalt chrome, and read at the scale of a port. Documents (the bill of lading, the ledger, the contact sheet) are cool off-white paper with hard ink rules.

The shipping container is the one standard object shared by every place in the story, so the system is global rather than national. Type is stencil display over a plain grotesque body, with monospace reserved for real ISO 6346 codes. Density is generous in sections and compact inside boxes; corners are square.

Motion is mechanical: boxes lift, seams widen, door leaves swing open to reveal the manifest.
keyCharacteristics: Flat-colour corrugated steel with SVG rib tile as the single material
Square corners everywhere; 3px ink or white borders
Stencil display, Archivo body, mono for codes only
Door seams, locking rods and corner castings as interactive vocabulary
Paper and ink for documents; asphalt for chrome

rules.name: The Code-Only Mono Rule
rules.body: Martian Mono sets ISO codes, document numbers, dates and data labels only. Never headings, buttons, body copy or decoration.

rules.name: The One-Material Rule
rules.body: Everything coloured is corrugated steel: a flat colour plus the SVG rib tile. No gradients-as-surfaces, glass, or second material. Paper and ink are documents, asphalt is chrome, concrete is ground.

rules.name: The Rib Fade Rule
rules.body: Ribs fade to flat colour beneath body copy (a 300px gradient from transparent to the section colour over the plain tile) so reading text never sits on corrugation.

rules.name: The Real Weight Rule
rules.body: Depth is a real offset shadow cast straight down (0 10px 18px up to 0 20px 28px, black at 22-40%). No glow, no blur halos, no coloured shadows.

rules.name: The Door Hardware Rule
rules.body: Interactive objects speak in door vocabulary: seams, locking rods, corner castings, leaves that swing open. Hover lifts the object; it never glows.

dos: Do build coloured surfaces from one palette colour plus the rib tile and a deeper bottom edge (8px on boxes).
Do set every h1-h3 in Big Shoulders Stencil, 900, uppercase, line-height 0.95.
Do keep corners square and borders 3px.
Do use ink-on-mustard and ink-on-steel text; white on red, blue and green.
Do give each section a focus outline colour that contrasts its ground (mustard, white or ink).
Do generate ISO codes with a computed check digit.
donts: Don't set body copy, headings or buttons in Martian Mono.
Don't add glow, blurred halos or coloured shadows.
Don't lay ribs under paragraphs of body copy; fade them out.
Don't round corners or introduce a second surface material.
Don't use more than one colour family per container.
